about.description:
The same design as the simple run with twice as many parts, so the work and the cost grow.

**What it teaches**

Map-reduce scales with the number of parts: the steps, the tokens and the cost, while the design stays the same.

**What to watch**

How many steps the run needs, and whether the reducer keeps all eight parts.

Read more: [Map-reduce](#/learn/map-reduce)
